description: q-Dirac character calculator + (k, ε, D_q²) cell scanner.  Computes q-Dirac eigenvalue, S-eigenvalue, depth, Plancherel weight for each partition of n=3,4,5,6,9,12.  Identifies which cells of the (curvature-rank, chirality, q-Dirac²) grid are populated and which contribute to α_EM, np splitting, and Q_β formulas.
